answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded staking: every agent must lock a costly deposit before it can transact, so cloning a thousand fake identities demands a thousand real bonds. Attackers face a barren tundra where capital freezes and slashing bites away gains. An honest agent's long-held stake becomes a relic of earned trust, and its reputation deepens from pale to rich umber as the bond survives epoch after epoch. Fake swarms simply cannot afford to exist.
